description:
[Results] Generate an interview result report (HTML/PDF/JSON) for a completed interview. The report is decision-support material for a human reviewer, not an automated hiring decision.

Generates an interview result report as a PDF (returns a signed URL), raw HTML, or structured JSON. Provide either `interview_result_id` for a single result or `interview_result_ids` for a combined multi-result report.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

ai_recruiter_assessment.description: Include the AI recruiter assessment: resume analysis, overall AI analysis, and the why-hire / why-not-hire summaries.

ai_scoring_rubric.description: Include the AI scoring rubric — the candidate-expectation buckets (strong / moderate / weak). Only takes effect when ai_recruiter_assessment is also true.

analytics.description: Include speech analytics for each answer (speech accuracy, fluency, recognition confidence, sentiment, cadence / words-per-minute).

answer_recording.description: Include a signed recording URL (audio/video) for each individual answer.

contact_details.description: Include the candidate's contact details (email, LinkedIn, phone number, physical address).

files.description: Include the candidate's uploaded files (resume and cover letter) as signed page URLs.

group_by_question.description: Group answers under their expected questions (instead of chronological order), including questions that were not reached.

mojito_language_code.description: Report language. Optional: if omitted, the report uses each result's own language code. If provided and it differs from the result's language, the report content is translated, which costs 0.1 credit per result.

session_recording.description: Include the full interview session recording and the video introduction as signed URLs.

template.description: Report layout for this export. Same values as the top-level `template`; the top-level field wins when both are given. Kept here so a saved auto-export configuration carries its template.

transcript.description: Include the full interview transcript: each question, the candidate answer, and the per-answer AI analysis.

interview_result_ids.description: Generate a single combined report for multiple results.

store_file.description: When true (pdf only), persist the file to storage and return a signed URL.

allOf.description: Report layout for this export. Same values as the top-level `template`; the top-level field wins when both are given. Kept here so a saved auto-export configuration carries its template.
Report layout: `classic`, `modern` or `one_pager`. Omit for the merchant default (modern when unset).

name: generate_interview_report

pdf_export_url.description: Signed URL of the generated PDF.

pdf_export_valid_until.description: ISO timestamp until which the signed URL is valid.

html_export.description: The full report rendered as an HTML document string.

table.description: Overview table HTML, present only for multi-result exports.

result.description: The generated report. Exactly one of the three shapes below is returned, selected by the request `export_type`: `pdf` → `{ pdf_export_url, pdf_export_valid_until }`; `html` → `{ html_export }`; `json` → `{ json_export }`.

title: Generate interview report
